# Adazing

> Adazing is a comprehensive software suite empowering authors with AI-powered tools for writing, book design, marketing, and reader engagement.

Adazing provides an integrated platform combining writing acceleration (QuickWrite), visual content creation (BookGraphix, BookVoice), social media marketing (Author Social Assistant), SEO optimization (Author Keywords), and promotional distribution (MyBookAds, BookPromoter) designed specifically for self-publishing authors. The Author Access subscription bundles these tools into a unified solution for the complete author workflow.

## Core Products & Services

- [Products - Adazing](https://www.adazing.com/products): Overview of Adazing product suite including QuickWrite, ReaderMachine, and BookVoice.
- [Author Access - Adazing](https://www.adazing.com/author-access): Author Access subscription service bundling writing, marketing, and promotion tools.
- [QuickWrite - Adazing](https://www.adazing.com/quickwrite): QuickWrite AI writing tool helping fiction authors write books 10x faster.
- [ReaderMachine - ReaderMachine.com](https://www.adazing.com/reader-machine): ReaderMachine teaches authors blogging strategies to attract loyal readers.

## Content Creation & Design Tools

- [BookGraphix - BookGraphix.com](https://www.adazing.com/bookgraphix): BookGraphix generates unlimited book mockups, graphics, and promotional videos.
- [BookVoice - Adazing](https://www.adazing.com/bookvoice): BookVoice creates AI-powered promotional videos and voiceovers for authors.
- [Author Social Assistant - Adazing](https://www.adazing.com/author-social-assistant): Author Social Assistant provides done-for-you social media graphics and content calendars.
- [Instant Book Mockup Generator - Free Ebook Cover Creator](https://www.adazing.com/cover-mocks): Free tool generating professional 3D book mockups in under 10 seconds.

## Marketing & Promotion Tools

- [MyBookAds - MyBookAds.com](https://www.adazing.com/mybookads): MyBookAds provides unlimited book advertising network for author promotion.
- [BookPromoter - BookPromoter.com](https://www.adazing.com/bookpromoter): BookPromoter schedules interviews, guest posts, and promotional placements.
- [Author Keywords - Adazing](https://www.adazing.com/author-keywords): Author Keywords generates SEO-optimized content ideas for author blogs.

## Free Author Tools

- [Book Title Generator - Perfect Titles In Less Than 30 Seconds](https://www.adazing.com/book-title-generator): Free book title generator providing creative title suggestions for authors.
